guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: emailservice_mem rose +37.9% (z=+7.59) after the alert, and it is the only series with a large, specific shift besides a latency-50 drop (z=-10.74) that more likely reflects failed or short-circuited requests than a healthy speedup. No other service shows a meaningful change (all other |z| < 1.6), the logs contain no warning or error lines, and the traces' error spans (checkoutservice, frontend, paymentservice) are consistent with checkoutservice failing on its emailservice dependency, though no trace shows emailservice itself.

proposed_fix.description: Restart or redeploy the emailservice pod to reclaim memory, then check for a memory leak or retained state. Restarting a single stateless replica is safe, and the heap and memory growth can be profiled before the restart.
